text: yeah lets do it! lets be able to make a light first before we do the sun
resolution: Slice 1 of authoring lights in the Studio mesh editor — 'make a light' before the sun. A light is now an authored part of a model (the user's pyramid): in rig mode a '+ light' button drops a downward white spot above the part, a chip row selects it, and a panel tunes it (spot/bulb toggle, colour swatches, brightness, reach, cone, tip x/y/z, aim x/y/z, casts-shadow). The Studio viewport emits each authored light as a Scene3D.SpotLight/PointLight (the req_2032 primitives) offset by the part's lift, so the model is lit live and a spot's shadow (req_2055) rides along. Data: LightRig type + EditMesh.lights with immutable addLight/updateLight/removeLight/nextLightName helpers and cloneMesh deep-copy; persistence is free because lights ride EditMesh through the partMeshUpdated whole-mesh JSON event into the V20 model store (branch data, undoable). Verified: 4 new editMesh light test suites pass (106/106 total, no regression) and the full hmsc-int cart bundles + ships clean. The Studio editor can't be headlessly screenshotted (known OOM), so live verification is rjit dev hmsc-int. Next slices: a draggable pyramid gizmo in the viewport, then carry lights through the cook into placed props + the /compiled world. Committed 18ee22130.
